dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Sure. I might need you to start us off, though. I don't usually chat with others.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Even when I was with the Fatui, I mostly sat in a corner during meetings and refrained from participating in debates.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: Most of the topics were boring anyway. Someone wants this, or to fight for that... And nobody would give an inch.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Guess she started off the conversation just fine...)

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: More vexing was how they would sometimes seek out my opinion.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: My eyes were always closed, and so they assumed that I was listening in silence. In truth, most of the time I was either sleeping, or simply not thinking about anything at all.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: But responding was not an issue. At times like those, I would pick one of the questioners and indicate that they were right. That always did the trick.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: If Regrator or The Rooster were arguing, I'd side with the latter. And if The Doctor and Arlecchino were locked in a debate, I'd pick Arlecchino.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: The Captain was always in the right, and while Sandrone could be quite stubborn, she was generally right as well.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: And if The Captain and Sandrone were to ask me at the same time? Hmm... That was quite rare. And were it to actually happen... I'd say that both sides had a point.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: They're both very independent-minded. My opinions would not alter their judgment.

dialogues.speaker: Columbina
dialogues.text: ...Eh? What did you want to talk to me about again...?

choices.text: Oh, don't worry. We're doing great.

response.speaker: Columbina
response.text: Is that so? Well, I'm glad you're enjoying yourself.

response.speaker: Columbina
response.text: In truth, I prefer speaking with kuuhenki rather than humans.

response.speaker: Columbina
response.text: Their thinking is pure and simple, and they do not hide their thoughts.

response.speaker: Columbina
response.text: "Let's play," "Tell me a story," "I want to sleep," "There's something nice over there"...

response.speaker: Columbina
response.text: Seen through their eyes, the world is simple and beautiful.
